function.name: video_games_store_currency
function.description: Fetches the currency used in a specific region in a gaming platform store. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch

region.description: The region e.g. United States, United Kingdom, Japan

function.name: video_games_on_sale
function.description: Checks if a particular game is currently on sale in a specific gaming platform store and in a specific region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_title.description: The title of the video game

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch

region.description: The region e.g. United States, United Kingdom, Japan. Default United States

function.name: video_games_store_price
function.description: Fetches the selling price of a specified game in a particular gaming platform store and in a specific region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_title.description: The title of the video game

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch

region.description: The region e.g. United States, United Kingdom, Japan. Default to United States
